messages:
maria: Heads up — need a quick sync on staging keystore access for SOC2 fieldwork. Auditors scheduled Wed 2026-06-10. Who's owning evidence pickup?

alex: I can own evidence extraction from staging. Quick Q: do we have the export script ready? PR #4722 is in review.

rahul: PR #4722 left a TODO re: mask_sensitive=true flag. I can push a small patch today.

maria: Thanks. @ops_jordan can you confirm staging KMS replica will be accessible from the audit VM? Last I heard network ACL was blocking.

ops_jordan: Confirming ACLs: audit subnet allowed, but need to open port 8443 for the audit agent. I'll add rule and ping when done :thumbsup:.

compliance-bot: Reminder: evidence retention policy requires manifest + SHA256 for artifacts. See https://internal/docs/compliance/evidence-spec.

sasha: Also flag: HSM attestation logs for timeframe 2026-05-01..2026-06-01 must be pulled. I have a script but need keystore read role. @alex can you grant?

alex: Grant done for role 'compliance-read' on keystore-staging. Please verify access.

sasha: Verified, can pull logs. Starting an initial sample run now.

rahul: Quick note, sample pull returned 3 entries with missing signature field. Might be earlier ingestion bug. Logging it as ticket SEC-987.

maria: Good catch. Can we get a timeline for fix and re-run? Auditors will accept a post-facto patch if we document the issue.

rahul: I can hotfix tomorrow morning, re-ingest by EOD. Ops can assist if we need to re-run pipeline.

ops_jordan: I'll standby during the window. Can we schedule 09:00 UTC? I'll make the port change earlier so it's smooth.

maria: 09:00 UTC works. Action items: alex grant (done), rahul hotfix + reingest (ETA EOD tomorrow), ops_jordan open port + assist 09:00, sasha pull attest logs and attach manifest. I'll prepare the evidence pack and notify auditors. Thanks everyone.
